purpose: Teach: レター/高性能/撮ら/商用/出所/明細/否め/バージョンアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様への新年レター、丁寧に、仕上げろ。
lines.en: Draft a careful letter to our VIP clients for the new year. Make sure it's polished.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Crisp attack on the opening phrase. No wasted words. Expectation of competence, not doubt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高性能の新製品、来月、発表予定です。
lines.en: Understood. We're scheduled to announce the new high-performance product next month.
lines.style: Professional, steady delivery. Slightly formal register — updating the boss. Even pacing, respectful but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広告で、社員、勝手に撮らないよう、徹底しろ。
lines.en: In any advertisements, make absolutely sure staff aren't photographed without permission. Be thorough about it.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Weight on the absolute requirement. Not harsh, but precise — this matters. Brief pause before the final instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商用ライセンス、契約手続き、進めております。
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with the commercial licensing agreements and contract procedures.
lines.style: Reassuring update. Calm, methodical delivery. Shows progress without overselling. Steady eye-contact level register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 情報の出所、必ず、確認してから、決裁しろ。
lines.en: Verify the source of any information before you approve it. Don't make exceptions.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Slight emphasis on verify — this is non-negotiable. Controlled, not angry. The tone of someone who has seen mistakes before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。請求書の明細、お得意様にも、ご提示しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're also providing itemized invoice details to our VIP clients as well.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Shows initiative without asking permission. Professional, unadorned. Slight anticipatory quality — already ahead of expectations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競争激化、否めない事実だ、対策、考えろ。
lines.en: Competition is intensifying. It's an undeniable reality. Start thinking about our response.
lines.style: Heavier tone. Matter-of-fact opening. Slight pause after stating the fact — letting it land. The final sentence is a shift from observation to expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内システム、バージョンアップ、来週、実施します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll be rolling out a system upgrade next week.
lines.style: Confident closing statement. Slightly faster pace — action already in motion. Demonstrates the response is underway. Minimal hesitation, clean finish.
